summary: iteration_15 frontend-only verification: Tailwind borderRadius override fix on /app/frontend/tailwind.config.js:35 is CONFIRMED WORKING. Full guest-login + project-creation + dashboard rename/delete cluster computed-style probe shows all target buttons now render at the intended 10px corners (NOT 0px). Tailwind utility ramp probe confirms sm=4/md=8/lg=10/xl=14/2xl=18/full=9999. Marketing, login pages still render without regressions. No console errors during dashboard render.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard route is /app, not /dashboard. The review_request copy referred to '/dashboard' but the SPA router uses '/app'. Direct nav to /dashboard redirects to '/' (landing). Cosmetic only — testids still match the iteration_11 spec (dashboard-rename-*, dashboard-delete-*).
Project-list response from POST /api/projects returns 200 (not the more idiomatic 201) — minor REST nit, not blocking.
Two harmless GET /api/auth/me 401s fire on initial landing-page mount before guest login (auth probe). Consider 200-with-null payload instead of 401 to keep the console clean for prospects.
test_credentials: Guest path: click [data-testid=login-guest-btn] on /login → lands on /app. No email/password needed.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 guest-scoped projects 'Radius A' and 'Radius B' via POST /api/projects (status 200 each) under the guest session for this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: tailwind.config.js line 35 borderRadius is now `{ none: '0', DEFAULT: '6px', sm: '4px', md: '8px', lg: '10px', xl: '14px', '2xl': '18px' }`. All rounded-* utilities in JSX now resolve to real pixel values. Dashboard route is /app (not /dashboard). Guest login: POST /api/auth/guest with {name, designation, avatar} OR click [data-testid=login-guest-btn] on /login. Project create payload: {project_name, engine:'free'}.
rca of the issue: iteration_11 root-caused the brutalist 0px corners on Dashboard rename/delete buttons to tailwind.config.js line 35 hard-overriding the borderRadius scale to 0 for sm/md/lg/xl, neutralising every `rounded-lg` className in the JSX. iteration_15 fix replaces the override with `{ none:'0', DEFAULT:'6px', sm:'4px', md:'8px', lg:'10px', xl:'14px', '2xl':'18px' }`. After supervisor restart, runtime computed border-radius on dashboard-rename-*, dashboard-delete-*, dashboard-rename-save-*, dashboard-rename-cancel-* all report 10px and DRAFT pill stays 9999px. Custom .card-brut (14px) and .btn-brut (10px) declared radii in index.css are unaffected because they set their own explicit radius via CSS. Fix verified.
